sources.rootReviewPolicy: Review source and native strip. Set neutralTopY to the actual crown/body top (exclude props), neutralBodyTopConfirmed=true and neutralBodyTopBasis. For every frame set rootX/rootY from both boots, bootPairSupportWitness=[left,top,right,bottom] covering both boot support bands, and manualRootBasis (or a shared manualRootReviewBasis). Run --render after edits, then explicit confirm with exact-hash visual assessment.
sources.rootBasis: All18 raw poses reviewed for both planted boots. Support rows contain two separated boot soles, not robe hems or gourd/sword pixels. Root lies between both sole centres at the source boot floor; foreshortening is retained. One neutral source scale only.

measurementConfirmation.scope: Manual world roots, body-top calibration and source components only; no motion ART or runtime approval
